mapper.update: /*insertMasterMpRqBulkQuotationItem*/ INSERT INTO KEP_BURQ_ITEM ( BURQ_NO, ITEM_KEY_ID, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, BUYER, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, AGENT, PO_CNT, ITEM_QTY, RE_LIST_PRICE, MAIN_BUYER, SG_ID, SM_USER_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_USER_ID )( SELECT BURQ_NO, ITEM_KEY_ID, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, BUYER, CONTRACT_NO, CONTRACT_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, AGENT, PO_CNT, ITEM_QTY, RE_LIST_PRICE, MAIN_BUYER, SG_ID, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD3 WHERE TYPE = 'CMSM' AND TEXT2 = 'Y' AND CODE2 = '1' AND CODE1 = SG_ID) SM_USER_ID , SYSDATE, TARGET, SYSDATE, TARGET FROM ( SELECT KEY_1 AS BURQ_NO, DECODE(#{st_project_unit},'B',TRIM(KEY_4)||'||'||TRIM(KEY_5)||'||'||KEY_6||'||'||KEY_7||'||'||TRIM(KEY_8),KEY_3||'||'||KEY_5||'||'||TRIM(KEY_8)) AS ITEM_KEY_ID, TRIM(KEY_3) BYIT_COMORG_CODE, TRIM(KEY_4) BUYER, TRIM(KEY_6) CONTRACT_NO, TRIM(KEY_7) CONTRACT_SEQ, TRIM(KEY_5) BUYER_ITEM_NO, TRIM(KEY_8) AGENT, TRIM(KEY_9) PO_CNT, TRIM(KEY_10) ITEM_QTY, TRIM(KEY_11) RE_LIST_PRICE, TRIM(KEY_12) MAIN_BUYER, ( SELECT SG_ID FROM CMSCATEG CMS, ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE BYIT.CMS_CATEG_ID = CMS.CMS_CATEG_ID AND BYIT.BUYER = DECODE(#{st_project_unit},'B',KEY_4, KEY_3) AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = KEY_5 ) SG_ID, TARGET FROM BNTTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'BURQ_ITEM' AND TARGET = #{USER_ID} AND KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no} ) )

/*insertMasterMpRqBulkQuotationRfqBuyerInit*/ INSERT INTO KEP_BURQ_RFQ ( BURQ_NO,ITEM_KEY_ID,AGENT,AGENT_TYPE,BYIT_COMORG_CODE,BUYER,STATUS,GPL_YN,ATOS_DATE,ATOS_END_DATE, KEP_DESCRIPTION,KEP_SPECIFICATION,KEP_MAKER_PART_NO,KEP_MAKER_CODE,KEP_MIN_ORDER_QTY,KEP_PUR_UNIT_QTY,KEP_UNIT_MEASURE, ADD_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, DELIVERY_LT, SM_PROCESS_TYPE, SM_PARCEL_YN, SM_WAREHOUSE_CODE )( SELECT A.BURQ_NO, KEY_4 || '||' || KEY_5 || '||' || KEY_6 || '||' || KEY_7 || '||' || KEY_8 AS ITEM_KEY_ID, KEY_8 AS AGENT, 'B' AS AGENT_TYPE, TRIM(KEY_3) AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, TRIM(KEY_4) AS BUYER, 'K3' AS STATUS, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE 'KRGPLK0001' = BYIT.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = TRIM(B.KEY_5)),0,'N','Y') AS GPL_YN, SYSDATE AS ATOS_DATE, A.RFQ_END_SCHD_DATE AS ATOS_END_DATE, C.DESCRIPTION, C.SPECIFICATION, C.MAKER_PART_NO, C.MAKER_CODE, NVL(C.MIN_ORDER_QTY,1) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY, NVL(C.PUR_UNIT_QTY,1) AS PUR_UNIT_QTY, C.UNIT_MEASURE, SYSDATE AS ADD_DATE, #{USER_ID} AS ADD_USER_ID, (SELECT DELIVERY_LT FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = C.BUYER AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS DELIVERY_LT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ' AND CODE = BURQ_NO AND COMPANY_CODE = KEY_4) as SM_PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ' AND CODE = BURQ_NO AND COMPANY_CODE = KEY_4) as SM_PARCEL_YN, (SELECT TEXT3 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ' AND CODE = BURQ_NO AND COMPANY_CODE = KEY_4) as SM_WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM KEP_BURQ_MNG A, BNTTRXL B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE A.BURQ_NO = B.KEY_1 AND TRIM(B.KEY_4) = C.BUYER AND TRIM(B.KEY_6) = C.CONTRACT_NO AND TRIM(B.KEY_7) = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND TRIM(B.KEY_5) = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.DOC_NAME = 'BURQ_ITEM' AND B.KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no} AND B.TARGET = #{USER_ID} )

/*insertMasterMpRqBulkQuotationRfqGroupInit*/ INSERT INTO KEP_BURQ_RFQ ( BURQ_NO,ITEM_KEY_ID,AGENT,AGENT_TYPE,BYIT_COMORG_CODE,BUYER,STATUS,GPL_YN,ATOS_END_DATE, KEP_DESCRIPTION,KEP_SPECIFICATION,KEP_MAKER_PART_NO,KEP_MAKER_CODE,KEP_MIN_ORDER_QTY,KEP_PUR_UNIT_QTY,KEP_UNIT_MEASURE, ADD_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, DELIVERY_LT, SM_PROCESS_TYPE, SM_PARCEL_YN, SM_WAREHOUSE_CODE )( SELECT A.BURQ_NO, KEY_3 || '||' || KEY_5|| '||' || KEY_8 AS ITEM_KEY_ID, KEY_8 AS AGENT, 'B' AS AGENT_TYPE, TRIM(KEY_3) AS BYIT_COMORG_CODE, TRIM(KEY_4) AS BUYER, 'K3' AS STATUS, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMBYIT BYIT WHERE 'KRGPLK0001' = BYIT.BUYER AND BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = TRIM(B.KEY_5)),0,'N','Y') AS GPL_YN, A.RFQ_END_SCHD_DATE AS ATOS_END_DATE, C.DESCRIPTION_LOC, C.SPECIFICATION, C.MAKER_PART_NO, C.MAKER_CODE, NVL(C.MIN_ORDER_QTY,1) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY, NVL((SELECT MAX(PUR_UNIT_QTY) FROM ICOMCQDT D WHERE D.BUYER = C.BUYER AND D.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO),1) AS PUR_UNIT_QTY, C.UNIT_MEASURE, SYSDATE AS ADD_DATE, #{USER_ID} AS ADD_USER_ID, C.DELIVERY_LT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ' AND CODE = BURQ_NO AND COMPANY_CODE = KEY_3) as SM_PROCESS_TYPE, (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ' AND CODE = BURQ_NO AND COMPANY_CODE = KEY_3) as SM_PARCEL_YN, (SELECT TEXT3 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ' AND CODE = BURQ_NO AND COMPANY_CODE = KEY_3) as SM_WAREHOUSE_CODE FROM KEP_BURQ_MNG A, BNTTRXL B, ICOMBYIT C WHERE A.BURQ_NO = B.KEY_1 AND TRIM(B.KEY_3) = C.BUYER AND TRIM(B.KEY_5) = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.DOC_NAME = 'BURQ_ITEM' AND B.KEY_1 = #{st_burq_no} AND B.TARGET = #{USER_ID} )
